notes.title: Sunken Engine Devlog #1
notes.content: [h1][b]Greetings from the shores of Blackreef,[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555273/13bc6d961a767f178151608ec12480f37673291d.png"][/img][/p][p]     We want to thank everyone who has shown interest in our game since we opened our store page—those who follow us, leave comments, and provide feedback. We also want to give a special thanks to everyone who made videos about our game and tried our demo on their streams. The interest you've shown in our demo has strengthened our belief in this project even more, and we're now working with even greater enthusiasm toward Early Access.[/p][p]     A few weeks ago, we shared our Early Access Roadmap outlining what we plan to do. Now, we’d like to talk a bit more about what’s on that roadmap, share our current progress, and hear your thoughts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555273/21db2ec1e055ace796839c1d5ce8fa544aacac74.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Simulation Mechanics[/b][/h3][p]     Sunken Engine is fundamentally a simulation game, and our goal has always been to deliver familiar mechanics in a new and distinctive way. We're working hard to make the simulation aspect as satisfying as possible. More varied ships, new repair mechanics, and a wider range of jobs are all part of that effort.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555273/7d0e97228ad5fb51e9df1c7c5dfe19700fca3ad5.gif"][/img][/p][p]     In Early Access, you’ll need to obtain a license before you can perform any job. You'll visit the town hall, pay the fee, and then be authorized to work in that field. We're planning to expand the variety of jobs by adding things like a Blacksmith License, Electronics License, Signals License, Carpentry License, and Locksmith License.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555273/25872bce014de6e2a27a07ca9a55863612cc25a4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Lovecraft Story[/b][/h3][p]     Although Sunken Engine is a simulation game at its core, it also contains Lovecraftian mystery and horror elements. In the demo you often encountered the Sunken Ones—dark, lurking creatures. In Early Access, you'll learn much more about them. You'll collect cursed objects to obtain "Nightmare Fuel," which will help you progress through the story and improve your abilities. Solving the mysteries aboard these cursed ships will require greater attention to detail.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555273/866d9ecae27af4c1a7dd1e65b1b44bb51d0ad6ea.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Visual Changes[/b][/h3][p]     We’ve been preparing for Early Access with all the feedback we received from the demo in mind. As part of that, we completely redesigned the character art from scratch. We believe these new designs better fit the tone of our game and better represent us.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555273/fa69ca4c92a5c3af80508a68964e5657765632ea.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Upgrades and Customizations[/b][/h3][p]     The demo had limited shop upgrades and customization options. We're updating and expanding these so you’ll be able to grow your workshop even further and tailor it to your own style.[/p][p][/p][p]     We're continuing to work on all this and more for Early Access. Thank you so much to everyone who has supported us and shared feedback so far.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone[/h1][p]First of all, we’d like to thank everyone who played our demo and shared their feedback and ideas for the future. The demo is currently available to play on Steam and will remain playable throughout Next Fest. During this time, we’ll be here to fix any bugs you might encounter in the demo, but beyond that, we’ve already started working on the Early Access version of the game.[/p][p]We have many new mechanics and story elements we’d like to add during the Early Access period, but for now, let’s talk about what you can expect when the game first launches into Early Access:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555273/21db2ec1e055ace796839c1d5ce8fa544aacac74.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Cursed Ships[/b]
These ships are vessels taken over by dark forces from the depths of the sea.
First, you’ll need to cleanse them of their curse—and then take care of their needs.
You may uncover hidden stories, secret compartments, and mysterious items on board.[/p][p][b]Necronomicon[/b]
Our greatest inheritance from our father.
The Necronomicon reveals things unseen to the naked eye and allows us to communicate with them.
As you learn to use the book, you’ll discover new curses and how to deal with them.
You’ll be able to banish creatures and curses using its knowledge.[/p][p][b]Fishing[/b]
Different fish, different stories—and the more you descend into madness, the more you’ll see.
You can sell the fish you catch at the market to earn extra income.
But remember—there’s more than just fish in the sea![/p][p][b]New Locations[/b]
Explore new places where you’ll encounter fresh stories or improve your abilities.
Don’t forget to stop by the doctor from time to time!
Bring any mysterious items you find to the antique dealer—he might be able to tell you what they are.[/p][p][b]Ship Variety[/b]
Expect to see different ships from various islands.
A scientist’s ship, a tourist vessel—each with unique stories and mysteries to uncover.[/p][p][b]Cursed Items[/b]
Some items you find on ships or from NPCs can be sold in the market.
But beware—some may be possessed by dark curses.[/p][p]The main storyline will begin with Act 1 and continue to expand with future updates![/p][p]Once again, thank you so much to everyone who tried our demo.
We hope you enjoyed it—and we can’t wait to see you again in Early Access with even more to experience![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]First of all, huge thanks to everyone who played our demo and shared their valuable feedback. We're doing our best to fix any issues as quickly as possible during development. Big thanks as well to those who reached out via the in-game [i]Bug Report[/i] system or through our Discord server — your support really helps us improve! [/p][p]Based on the feedback so far, we’ve made several updates:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed font issues in some languages[/p][/*][*][p]Made character movement smoother[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where faxes wouldn't arrive[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved collider and dirt-related bugs on ships[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition to that, we’ve also addressed a few other bugs and missing elements we noticed ourselves, and pushed out some quick updates.[/p][p]If you come across any issues moving forward, feel free to reach out via the in-game bug report feature or our Discord server.[/p][p]Once again, thank you so much to everyone who tried the demo and took the time to share their thoughts. Your support means a lot during this development journey! [/p]
